title: CAD Tool Worker system design
summary: The Python CAD Tool Worker claims bounded tool jobs, derives trusted source context, applies registered operations in memory, and uploads only a complete isolated candidate.

nodes.label: CAD Tool Jobs
nodes.description: Postgres rows are the durable Nest-to-Python handoff for prepare_context and apply_plan work.

details.responsibility: Own queued, leased, completed, and failed bounded CAD tool jobs.
durableReads: next queued job and request payload
durableWrites: lease heartbeat, structured result, or bounded failure

nodes.label: Python CAD Tool Worker
nodes.description: A polling Python process with no OpenAI dependency and no canonical-source commit authority.

details.responsibility: Claim one tool job, maintain its lease, and complete or fail it with bounded workflow errors.
guarantees: The worker has no prompt or model-reasoning dependency.
It never writes canonical model.py or marks edit_jobs complete.

operations.concurrency: One claimed job is executed at a time per process.
operations.retry: No process-local retry; failed rows record a terminal tool outcome.

nodes.label: Bounded Context Builder
nodes.description: Resolves the authoritative requested part or one unambiguous project match and builds editable source context.

details.responsibility: Prepare source, targets, fingerprints, dependency paths, parameter consumers, and metadata warnings for planning.
guarantees: A linked requested_part_id is authoritative and cannot be redirected to another better-ranked part.
Ambiguous or stale context fails before planning.

nodes.label: Transactional Tool Executor
nodes.description: Validates the complete versioned plan and applies registered AST/source operations only in memory.

details.responsibility: Enforce scope, source hashes, target fingerprints, ownership policy, dependency impact review, and final source contract.
details.successCondition: Every operation and the final source contract pass before one candidate upload.

failureConditions.condition: Any operation, policy, fingerprint, or contract check fails

nodes.label: Canonical CAD Source
nodes.description: 3dProjects owns accepted model.py and params.json used for context preparation and base-hash verification.

details.responsibility: Durably own accepted source; this worker reads it but never promotes a candidate to it.

nodes.label: Candidate Storage
nodes.description: 3dProjects edit-scoped candidate paths hold only a fully applied proposed model.py.

details.responsibility: Durably hold an isolated candidate for independent validation; it is not canonical source.

nodes.label: NestJS CAD Agent
nodes.description: The separate control plane queues bounded work and later consumes the structured result.

details.responsibility: Own planning, durable orchestration, proof-gated commit, and public progress outside this worker.

edges.label: claim, heartbeat, and complete bounded job

response.label: leased tool job or result acknowledgement

details.durability: Postgres is the handoff and lifecycle source of truth, not a WebSocket or in-memory queue.

edges.label: read and verify accepted base hash

details.failureBehavior: No upload occurs until every operation and final source contract have passed.

boundaries.label: Python CAD Tool Worker runtime
boundaries.description: Deterministic context preparation and source-tool execution only.
